title: Playboy Magazine Lot 1987 1989 1990 Pam Anderson + 1 Bonus Magazine (See Photos)
descriptionText:
Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from 1987, 1989 and 1990. Includes the November 1987 Jessica Hahn issue, December 1987 Christmas issue featuring Brigitte Nielsen, September 1989 Playmate Twins issue, and February 1990 issue featuring the Women of Russia and Eddie Murphy interview. The February 1990 issue also features Pamela Anderson as Playmate of the Month.

Magazines are pre-owned vintage copies and show normal signs of age, storage and handling. Covers may have light edge wear, corner wear, surface marks, creases or other age-related imperfections. Please review all photos carefully for the exact condition of the magazines included.

Includes:

* November 1987
* December 1987
* September 1989
* February 1990

All four magazines shown in the photos are included. Great lot for Playboy collectors, vintage magazine collectors, or fans of 1980s and 1990s pop culture.
